$comment: TabStudio's toolchain catalog: the single list of the toolchains TabStudio knows, what to install for each, how to run its programs, and its language server and debug adapter. Toolchains with "listed": true appear in the Toolchain Store; the others are described here so the IDE can recognize their projects and so they can be finished by switching that flag on. Package names are Alpine Linux's, for the branch below. See docs in src/TabStudio.Toolchains/Catalog/ToolchainCatalog.cs.

file.content:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
sdk=/opt/tabstudio/android/sdk
mkdir -p "$sdk/cmdline-tools" "$sdk/platforms" "$sdk/build-tools"
rm -rf "$sdk/cmdline-tools/latest" "$sdk/platforms/android-35" "$sdk/build-tools/35.0.0"
cp -a /opt/tabstudio/android/commandline/cmdline-tools "$sdk/cmdline-tools/latest"
cp -a /opt/tabstudio/android/platform/* "$sdk/platforms/android-35"
cp -a /opt/tabstudio/android/buildtools/* "$sdk/build-tools/35.0.0"
# Replace every native SDK executable that Gradle uses; d8 and apksigner run on the JVM.
if [ -d /opt/tabstudio/android/native/build-tools ]; then
  for tool in aapt aapt2 aidl zipalign dexdump split-select; do
    [ ! -f "/opt/tabstudio/android/native/build-tools/$tool" ] || cp "/opt/tabstudio/android/native/build-tools/$tool" "$sdk/build-tools/35.0.0/$tool"
  done
fi
chmod +x "$sdk"/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/* "$sdk"/build-tools/35.0.0/* 2>/dev/null || true
chmod +x /opt/tabstudio/android/gradle/gradle-8.9/bin/gradle
# This command runs only after the Store has shown Google's SDK license and the user accepts it.
yes | "$sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" --sdk_root="$sdk" --licenses >/dev/null
"$sdk/build-tools/35.0.0/aapt2" version
java -cp "$sdk/build-tools/35.0.0/lib/d8.jar" com.android.tools.r8.D8 --version

setup.name: Kotlin language server
setup.description: fwcd's kotlin-language-server, which Alpine does not package.

setup.name: Retire legacy Android Gradle shim
command:
if [ -f /usr/local/bin/gradle ] && cmp -s /usr/local/bin/gradle - <<'TABSTUDIO_OLD_ANDROID_GRADLE'
#!/bin/sh
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk
exec /opt/tabstudio/android/gradle/gradle-8.9/bin/gradle "$@"
TABSTUDIO_OLD_ANDROID_GRADLE
then
  rm /usr/local/bin/gradle
fi

toolchains.name: ESP-IDF
toolchains.description: ESP-IDF 6.1 at an exact source revision, including pinned submodules, in the shared Ubuntu environment. Espressif SHA-256-verifies native Xtensa/RISC-V archives for all targets. Python releases, build tools and vendor constraints are SHA-256 locked; installation needs several GB.
